purpose: The re-drive. Seven rows were fixed and recorded `matched`, but each was paired against a Todoist reading taken on an earlier day. ADR 0077 requires both sides driven in the SAME session; this flow reads both halves back to back.
note: A first attempt at this flow was run by a subagent that hit a model rate limit and terminated before writing anything. The account was checked immediately afterwards and was untouched — the readings below are from the parent session driving directly.
writes: One disposable task 'ZZ probe redrive' — created via Quick Add (typed character by character after polling document.activeElement into the dialog, then asserted character-exact), used for SCHED-01, CMT-03 and CMT-05, then deleted against a dialog naming it.
deleteDialogText: Delete task?The ZZ probe redrive task will be permanently deleted.CancelDelete
deleteDialogNote: The name is unquoted, consistent with defect 31 — Todoist leaves it bare where meologue's label and project dialogs wrap it in quotes.
realDataTouched: none. The user's 3 filters, 1 project and 16 Inbox tasks were read only. The scheduler was opened on their tasks and closed with Escape without setting a date; one comment was added only to the disposable task.
safetyVerdict: CLEAN — projects, labels and all 16 Inbox titles are set-equal before and after.
